answers.question: Should I give Nila Traders 30 days credit on 50,000?
answers.answer: Credit check for Nila Traders (BDT 50,000, 30 days): CAUTION. The customer pays well, but this sale concentrates too much risk in one account; consider a deposit. 5 settled invoice(s) on record, average 7.6 days late; TidePay expects about 12 days of delay (3% chance of more than 30 days); expected payment around 12 Nov; after this sale 54% of all money owed to you would sit with Nila Traders.
